title: Deprem GPT: code, pre-registrations and results for a transformer point process trained on several earthquake catalogs
description: Code, pre-registrations, result summaries and figures for the study A transformer trained on several earthquake catalogs outperforms ETAS after large earthquakes (Yıldırım, submitted to Geophysical Research Letters). A small decoder-only transformer treats each earthquake as a token and forecasts the time, magnitude and location of the next event. It is compared with regionally fitted ETAS models in pre-registered prospective tests on the 2023 Kahramanmaraş, 2024 Noto and 2024 Hualien sequences. Raw catalogs and model weights are not included. The scripts download or rebuild them.
